hooks.command: filepath="$TOOL_INPUT_PATH"; case "$filepath" in *.py) cd backend 2>/dev/null && uv run ruff format "$filepath" 2>/dev/null && uv run ruff check --fix "$filepath" 2>/dev/null ;; *.ts|*.tsx) cd frontend 2>/dev/null && pnpm biome check --fix "$filepath" 2>/dev/null ;; esac; exit 0
filepath="$TOOL_INPUT_PATH"; lines=$(wc -l < "$filepath" 2>/dev/null || echo 0); if [ "$lines" -gt 200 ]; then echo "ERROR: $filepath has $lines lines (max 200). Split this file."; exit 1; fi; exit 0
if echo "$TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qE 'rm\s+-rf\s+/'; then echo 'BLOCKED: destructive rm -rf'; exit 1; fi; exit 0
